name: &8Knights and Kings
description: Main menu (/menu): one tile per ported feature. Content port CP1.

variableBindings.expression: &7A list of all items in the game
&7See every premium tier and your own
&7Teleport to important points in the world
&7See what they produce and how they are doing

name: &8Kits
description: Every kit the viewer can see, claim or buy (kits.available). Content port CP2.

variableBindings.expression: &7Premium kits are bought once, then claimed

name: &8Your profile
description: The viewer's balances, title progress, premium tier and every title bracket. Content port CP3.

name: &8Item catalogue
description: Every item blueprint as granted, searchable, filterable by category and paged (items.catalog). Content port CP4.

variableBindings.expression: &7A list of all items in the game
&7(after the last one: every category again)

name: &8Premium tiers
description: Every premium tier (premium permission groups by weight) and the viewer's own. Content port CP5.

name: &8Player manager
description: Online players the viewer outranks (users.online; with knk.admin.user.manage.all every player, online and offline, self included) -> the editor. Content port CP8.

name: &8Edit player
description: Steppers for coins/gems/XP, title, groups, mode, salary, freeze, kick, ban for the player in ctx.userId/ctx.name. Content port CP8.

variableBindings.expression: &7Pays the salary owed since the last payout
&7Frozen players can't move, chat or use commands

name: &8Set title
description: Pick a title bracket for the player in ctx.userId (users.titles); sets their XP to its minimum. Content port CP8.

actions.paramsJson: {"actionTypeId":"users.set-title","actionParamsJson":"{\"userId\":\"$ctx.userId$\",\"bracketId\":\"$row.getBracketId$\"}","prompt":"Set $ctx.name$'s title to $row.getName$ (XP becomes $row.getMinExperience$)? Click Confirm or Cancel."}

name: &8Groups
description: Every permission group; click to add the player in ctx.userId or (confirmed) remove them (users.groups). Ranks (Default + premium tiers) are one per player: a rank click is a confirmed switch and removing a premium rank drops back to Default (plugin-side). Content port CP8.

name: &8Discoveries
description: Every discoverable town, district, structure and gate with the viewer's progress (discoveries.rows). Domain discovery KNG-20.

variableBindings.expression: &7(after the last one: every type again)

name: &8Teleport to spawnpoints
description: The viewer's warp destinations (teleport.destinations), spawn and pending /tpa requests. Teleport KNG-17 Phase 6.

name: &8Statistics privacy
description: Who may see each of the viewer's statistics, per group, with a confirmed group action (statistics.visibility.rows). Player statistics KNG-34.

variableBindings.expression: &8Friends-only shows nothing until the friends system exists

name: &8Statistics
description: A player's statistics (ctx.target, default the viewer) as the API shows them to the viewer, per group and period, plus the title history (statistics.main.title-history). Player statistics KNG-34.

name: &8Leaderboards
description: Every leaderboard (statistics.leaderboards.boards); a click opens it. Player statistics KNG-34.

variableBindings.expression: &7You appear on a board when you show

name: &8Leaderboard
description: One leaderboard (ctx.board): top 10 and the viewer's rank per period (statistics.leaderboard.entries). Player statistics KNG-34.

name: &8Structures
description: Every production structure and warehouse with search and Town, Kind and Status filters (structures.overview); the Town filter starts on the town the player stands in. Production P6 (M2).

variableBindings.expression: &7Click one to see what it produces

name: &8Structure
description: One production structure or warehouse (ctx.structureId): public details for everyone; rates, workers, warnings, storages and the orders entry for town members and staff; staff buttons (survey now, dry run, area outline). Production P6 (M1, M3-M5).

variableBindings.expression: &7Click to see open and recent orders
&7Asks the game server to survey the areas now
&7Shows what the automatic transport would do
&7Shows the production areas' outlines for a while

name: &8Transport orders
description: Open and recent transport orders of one structure (ctx.structureId): cargo, from, to, state and expected arrival; staff can cancel or retry (with a confirm). Town members and staff only. Production P6 (M1, M3, M4).

name: &8Shop
description: A shop's catalogue (ctx.shopId): legacy V1 "Products of X". Production P10b (#687), shops DESIGN § 8.

variableBindings.expression: &7See what the shop pays for your items

name: &8Shop item
description: One item of a shop (ctx.shopId, ctx.item): amount, price, description, buy. Legacy V1 item info. P10b (#687).

name: &8Confirm purchase
description: The purchase confirmation (ctx.shopId, ctx.item, ctx.amount): the quoted price, confirm or cancel. Legacy V1 confirm. P10b (#687).

variableBindings.expression: &7Buy it and claim it later with /inbox
